notes.title: We're excited to announce the next game from Draknek & Friends: Spooky Express
notes.content:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed [i]Bonfire Peaks[/i], then you might also enjoy what we've been working on lately here at Draknek & Friends.

Announcing: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/]Spooky Express[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/83e82ab61856c744ba366a8e814e5b0fc8468bd8.png[/img]

Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park!
All the passengers are all just [i]dying[/i] to ride the Spooky Express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif[/img]

Pick up the creepy cryptids and drop them at their destinations around the park. But be careful! Don’t let them scare or bite the human passengers. Stay [i]on track[/i] of the situation or you’ll have a [i]grave[/i] problem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

Spooky Express is great follow-up to our other award-winning thinky puzzle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/583270/Cosmic_Express/]Cosmic Express[/url] and will feature over 100 unique levels with countless monsters, maps and mechanics.

If that sounds like something you might be interested in, please give us a wishlist on Steam, or share the trailer below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uewJWzD6s10

...And that's not all. If you want to hear even more about Spooky Express, we've just released a special episode of the [url=https://www.draknek.org/podcast]Draknek & Friends Official Podcast[/url]. Tune in wherever you get your podcasts to hear creative director Alan Hazelden and producer Syrenne McNulty chat to the level designer Lucas Le Slo about the development of the game, and some of the other projects he's involved in.

Until next time 👋

notes.title: Sokobond Express is available today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share that Sokobond Express, a beautifully minimalist puzzle game that combines chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding in novel ways, is out on Steam now. Please enjoy and leave a Steam review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701330/Sokobond_Express/

Sokobond Express is developed by José Hernández, a first time commercial developer living in Venezuela. After several years of hard work and refining the game until it felt just right, Hernández is excited for players to finally be able to play it.

“Working on Sokobond Express for the last three years has been a real joy. I think the hardest thing to pull off in the game was the pacing - making levels get progressively harder while remaining engaging took a really long time. We spent a lot of time redesigning early-game levels to make them the perfect difficulty. We're really proud of how things ended up, so please check it out!”- José Hernández

If you’re a fan of other Draknek games, we know Sokobond Express  will be right up your alley. 
It combines the pathfinding of Cosmic Express with the deep but elegant atom building from Sokobond - paying homage to its predecessors while also being an elegant and entrancing game of its own.

Finally, the game is Steam Deck verified. Whether you're playing on Windows, macOS, Linux, or the Steam Deck, the game should provide a native and excellent play experience.

We can’t wait for you to play this puzzle masterpiece.

Thanks,
Draknek & Friends

notes.title: The Lost Memories DLC is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey!  I’m Corey, director and programmer/musician of Bonfire Peaks. 

Since the game released in September 2021, we’ve been actively developing a trilogy of DLC called Lost Memories, a near-sequel’s worth of puzzles which will be released in 3 parts. I’m excited to announce that part 1 is OUT NOW!

Buying the DLC now will also entitle you to parts 2 and 3 when they’re available. We haven’t set a date for those yet, but they’re in active development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008250/Bonfire_Peaks__Lost_Memories/

(Note: Lost Memories can be played on a fresh save file, but for best experience you should play through Bonfire Peaks first. If not, the DLC will be a strange introduction to a bunch of the deep-game mechanics and twists.)

Bonfire Peaks is many times bigger than I originally intended. It eventually got TOO big and, in order to ship, co-designer Alan Hazelden and I had to make hard decisions to cut entire puzzle mechanics, and dozens of puzzles along with them.

Unfortunately, the content we cut was among my favourite stuff in the game! In the true spirit of Bonfire Peaks, maybe I should have moved on and been done with it, but… I really want this stuff to exist in the world. I think it’s really good. So, we decided to take the time to polish and finish it as a 3-part DLC. One part for each “category” of puzzle we had cut.

All that is to say that this DLC is not an afterthought (some of the levels were made back in 2019!) and I’m so excited that the first of the 3 parts is finally out. Bonfire Peaks isn’t for everyone, but if you played and had a good time with it, then I’m sure this DLC will be like reconnecting with an old friend.

Happy roasting,
Corey

notes.title: Lost Memories part 1 coming March 2
notes.content:
Lost Memories is a 3-part DLC for this critically beloved puzzle game, with each part bringing new mechanics and more lovingly-constructed puzzles.

[previewyoutube=C4aYKw0ae2M;full][/previewyoutube]

Lost Memories part 1 is roughly 1/4 the size of the base game, and will be available on March 2. Parts 2 & 3 are under active development.

notes.title: v1.1.1 - Many bugs squashed!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

I've just pushed a new patch of bug fixes. Nothing too glamorous, just more stability. :) 

Also ICYMI - the first chapter of "Lost Memories" DLC is coming soon, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008250/Bonfire_Peaks__Lost_Memories/]wishlist here[/url]!

[h2]v1.1.1 Patch Notes[/h2]

[spoiler]- Fixed many situations where moves were incorrectly disallowed / allowed
- Fixed a handful of frame-specific undo/reset bugs
- Fixed a few bugs where crates joined by arrows could disconnect
- Fixed a few bugs where crumble blocks didn't crumble when they should
- Fixed a few bugs where crates didn't get impaled on spikes when they should
- Fixed a few bugs where crates could intersect
- Fixed a few bugs where arrows snapped when they shouldn't and vice versa
- Improved logic around when crates get pushed by a rotation vs when they get carried
- Fixed a bunch of bugs where crates that are carried by a rotation could do spooky things
- Fixed a softlock (seen in "Bodyguard")
- Disallow queueing of repeated "grab" action
- Fixed 2x2x1 shape with joined arrows could float
- Fixed crate incorrectly falling when a crate it's joined to is supported by a crumble block[/spoiler]

Fixed bugs where, under very specific circumstances, ...

[spoiler]- Player could walk through crates
- Flying crate doesn't fire when it should (seen in "Bodyguard")
- Climbing into a stack of crates pushes them too far 
- Wall spikes push crates by 2 tiles rather than 1
- Crate on head while climbing causes ghost pushing
- Movement incorrectly allowed while an arrow was mid-air (seen in "Turning The Corner")[/spoiler]

notes.title: Photo Mode available now!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce that Photo Mode is available today! Please enjoy taking photos as you climb the mountain (and share them with us!). Here are the patch notes for our v1.1.0 update:

- Added Photo Mode! 
- Fixed several position rounding bugs at low framerates
- Fixed several rotation-based bugs at low framerates
- Minor edit to level "Moving Day"
- Fixed a softlock in level "Bodyguard"
- Minor mesh optimizations
- Audio mix edits

But also! Today, as part of the Draknek Direct 2022, we announced Bonfire Peaks: Lost Memories, a trilogy of DLC. Each chapter will include new puzzles and new mechanics, and Chapter One will be available in Q3 2022. 

[previewyoutube=d6rVGPZA7fg;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008250/Bonfire_Peaks__Lost_Memories/

One last thing - Bonfire Peaks is now part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, running from the 19th-23rd of May. Get the game on discount and explore the showcase to find your next favorite puzzle game, too!

notes.title: Photo Mode coming soon and v1.0.27 bug fix patch now live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-kIfKvbdJwY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Photo Mode is coming soon to Bonfire Peaks! [/h1]

[h3]We'll post another update along with some exciting news soon. [/h3]
[h3]In the meantime, here's some patch notes for some issues I fixed in v1.0.27, live now:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Controller mapping is now displayed properly, but still not remappable
[*] Made snowy ground tiles easier to read
[*] Reduced polycount on some models to improve performance
[*] Fixed a bug where [spoiler]arrows can be pushed/pulled sideways into/out of arrow traps [/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug where walking on a supported 2x1 that's above a crate that's above [spoiler]spikes incorrectly impales the crate[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a few bugs where crates weren't being carried when they should
[*] Mouse click in pause menu no longer deselects the active button
[*] Fixed overworld lighting not updating after undoing an overworld reset
[*] Walking on a 2x1 supported by both a crate and a [spoiler]crumbling block no longer crumbles the block[/spoiler]
[*] Undo state wasnt being tracked if you pivot without holding something, now it is
[*] Fixed a bug where collisions werent being checked if you quickly changed directions mid-move
[*] Fixed a bug where you could clip [spoiler]arrow-joined crates[/spoiler] through solid objects
[*] Fixed a few bugs where you could [spoiler]separate two crates joined by an arrow[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a handful of edge cases where you could get stuck at a 45° angle
[*] Fixed a "pulling a crate out of an [spoiler]arrow trap while it was trying to fire[/spoiler]" bug found in Bodyguard
[*] Fixed a softlock that was possible in level Bodyguard
[/list]

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks - out now!
notes.content:
Today, in partnership with director Corey Martin, Draknek & Friends is thrilled to announce that Bonfire Peaks is now available, with a 10% launch discount for the first week.

After three years in development the full game is a wonderful experience with over 200 puzzles. If you've played any Draknek game before we know you'll love this as well. Bonfire Peaks is our first foray into game publishing and we couldn't be happier with the result - expect a master class in puzzle design brought to life through beautiful voxel artwork and an atmospheric soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Some early reviews:

[list]
[*] "Bonfire Peaks is a gorgeous experience, with a multitude of puzzles that will challenge even the most hardened genre aficionado." - Finger Guns, 9/10
[*] "A deeply thoughtful, eminently accessible and cleverly crafted bite-sized puzzler, Bonfire Peaks has more subtle emotion, charm and smile-cracking ingenuity than most of the games that have released this year." - PSU, 9.5/10
[*] "It’s a mostly sublime experience that is somehow equally demanding and relaxing, and uncovering all of its secrets offers an opportunity to flex your brain to the max." - Retroware, 9/10
[*] EDGE, 9/10
[/list]

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks is coming Q3 2021
notes.content:
Hello puzzle game fans!

We’re excited to announce that Bonfire Peaks, our first publishing venture with developer Corey Martin, will launch later this year in Q3 2021 on PC, Mac, and Linux on Steam. This game lines up perfectly with our portfolio of games like A Monster’s Expedition, and if you’ve liked our past games, we’re confident you’ll love this one too.

[previewyoutube=nlRYgY-Oa30;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re excited for the game like us and want to get a notification as soon as the game releases, be sure to wishlist the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Move onwards, move upwards, and leave nothing behind: in Bonfire Peaks, players must climb to the top of a mysterious island ruin, burning everything they own along the way. Featuring hours of masterfully designed puzzle content, a breathtakingly lovely voxel overworld, and not a single second of filler content.

2021 is shaping up to be Draknek & Friends’ biggest year ever, and we can’t wait to share all that we have in store for you.

Bonfire Peaks

is a very irresponsible game. Oh, it looks lovely, but I’m certain there must be laws against setting fire to crates of garbage all the way up the side of a mountain, even if you have to wrap your head around some peculiar puzzles to do so. There’s a demo out the now – and at the very least, it’s a good excuse to keep those arson inclinations firmly locked behind your monitor.
